title: EU B2B Compliance & AI-Search Auditor Input

targets.title: Targets (URLs, Domains, SIREN/SIRET numbers or Company Names)
targets.description: Enter URLs (e.g., https://example.com), company domain names, SIREN/SIRET numbers, or legal corporate names. Test in 1 click with the pre-filled sample!

audit_depth.title: Audit Depth
audit_depth.description: Select the inspection level: Quick (Homepage & Robots), Deep (Homepage, Legal Pages, llms.txt, Well-Known & Registry), or Full Enterprise (Deep + AI-Action Plan generation).
enumTitles: Deep (Comprehensive scan: legal pages, registry & llms.txt)
Full Enterprise (Complete audit + prioritized commercial action plan)

verify_official_registry.title: Verify Official EU/French Registries
verify_official_registry.description: Query official open government registry (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr) to verify SIREN, SIRET, NAF/APE code, VAT number, and legal executives.

check_ai_readiness.title: Audit AI Search & LLM Engine Readiness (GEO)
check_ai_readiness.description: Verify /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, Schema.org JSON-LD, OpenAPI specs, and robots.txt rules for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.

check_gdpr_legal.title: Audit GDPR & French Legal Notice Compliance
check_gdpr_legal.description: Verify mandatory legal notices (Mentions Légales, Host info, publication director, SIRET displayed) and detect third-party trackers.

gemini_api_key.title: Google Gemini API Key (Optional Self-Healing Booster)
gemini_api_key.description: Optional Gemini API key for advanced self-healing on blocked/obfuscated web pages and personalized AI strategic audit synthesis. If omitted, built-in heuristic rules take over.

max_retries.title: Max Retries per Target
max_retries.description: Number of retries when encountering rate limits or slow responses.

timeout_per_target_seconds.title: Timeout per Target (seconds)
timeout_per_target_seconds.description: Maximum seconds allowed per target scan before self-healing fallback concludes the report.
